atct.inspection: Official version table inspected through web; direct download returned HTTP 403. H/O values and source identifiers reuse the pinned major-molecule reference. Covariance is unavailable; no independent-error propagation.

iupac2005.inspection: OH section pp. 633–638 inspected through the official author-hosted PDF web extraction; no local PDF bytes retrieved. Numerical nodes selected from p. 637.
iupac2005.known_janaf_defect: Ground electronic degeneracy and multiplicity are treated incorrectly; caloric increments and formation-enthalpy temperature corrections are affected (pp635,638).
iupac2005.ancestry: Thermal functions adopted from Gurvich 1989 direct rovibrational sums, not independent of the NASA/Gurvich thermal model.

mythos2025.inspection: Full author-hosted paper inspected, especially sections4,6.2,6.3.
claims: 8000 K line list with 10606 states; Jmax=49.5. The 99.87% convergence metric at 10000 K is a last-shell diagnostic, not a rigorous omitted-tail bound.
Only X/A states below the X dissociation limit are strictly bound; higher included states may be quasi-bound. Continuum is excluded.
Barklem-Collet and Sauval-Tatum require a nuclear-spin factor of 2 for comparison.
mythos2025.limits: Spectral accuracy and opacity reach do not imply quantified thermodynamic uncertainty. MYTHOS and MoLLIST share empirical spectroscopy.

brooke2016.inspection: Author preprint arXiv:1503.08420v2 inspected, section 7; accepted Bristol manuscript URL returned HTTP 403.
claims: X-state levels through v=13; Jmax depends on v; Q is tabulated at 5–6000 K.
Unresolved H hyperfine is represented by multiplying each level weight by 2.

decision: Prioritize a replacement candidate for inherited JANAF/FastChem OH: known source defects plus modern source comparison justify follow-up. This source review itself does not adopt coefficients or run finite substitutions.
